content.purpose: Provide a DID-addressed maritime port operations service (port + vessel + call + container + incident) as an auditable, open-source reference implementation.

architectureDescriptionContext.mission: Provide tamper-evident, DID-native maritime port primitives open to any AT Protocol client.

content.findings: Vessel-call lifecycle + manifest sufficient for post-hoc port operations record. Severity DMN routes critical pollution / DG events to coast-guard audit feed.
content.recommendations: Add AIS subscription, integrate IMO IMDG dangerous-goods stowage rules, link to open-network for terminal connectivity.
